verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of automation is a single marketing line saying Pulse 'helps you automate bookkeeping, track payouts, monitor expenses.' The compliance calendar shows doola tracking recurring obligations on the user's behalf. The Partner API, webhooks and MCP server are developer building blocks rather than user-configurable background automations, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation or workflow rules, evidence that tasks run autonomously without manual calls (for example, annual reports still need separate submit and confirm calls), any depth on how Pulse automation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
